descriptions.notStarted: As #p1101002# has said, you must reach Lv.10 before you can become a Knight-in-Training. Let's head over to #b#m130010000##k to find #b#p1102000#, the Training Instructor#k.
descriptions.inProgress: You met #p1102000#, the Training Instructor, in #m130010000#. According to #p1102000#, there isn't a single monster in Ereve, so you must train against illusory creatures named Mimis, which #p1101001# summons. Then #p1102000# asked that you hunt #r#o100122##ks.
